rows.text: The President's communique dated 18 May 2009 states that Prime Minister Dr. Manmohan Singh has tendered his resignation and that of his colleagues in the Council of Ministers.
The same communique states that the President has accepted the resignation.

The same communique states that the President requested Dr. Manmohan Singh and the members of the Council of Ministers to continue in office till alternative arrangements are made (the headline says 'further arrangements').

bounded_scope: Head-of-government observations for CLAUDE-C01-11 only. The President's appointment, the oath or swearing-in, stated effective dates, confidence motions and votes, resignation announcements, letters and acceptances, requests to continue in office and attestations during a continuation stay separate rows; holder boundaries are decided in the packet, not by any row. Deputy prime ministers, ministers, the President and party offices are excluded.
